title: Expose source capability reports through the local channel
changes: Add an authenticated read-only cheats capabilities query and direct control form returning bounded UTF-8 chunks of the immutable source-capability report, its SHA-256 and snapshot generation.
Advertise a separate channel capability, refuse older servers before sending, preserve original-entry detail format, and add command completion and operation metadata.
validation: Frozen offline Windows GNU test and runtime builds passed without compiler messages or source drift across 1941 files. Wine passed 13 cheat tests (one ignored), 9 command, 4 completion, 31 control and 4 operation tests, including multi-part UTF-8 reconstruction, invalid offsets and generation, and old-server refusal.

A synthetic isolated Wine/Xvfb interpreter returned the same capability report via CLI, console and direct control with matching hash; stale generation was refused, paused guest and protected inputs remained unchanged, and session/display closed.
limitations: Source-bound reports remain assumptions and do not verify device behavior, actual ROM checksum or gameplay. Native Windows, Linux and physical input were not tested; the runtime parity proof used one synthetic report part, while multi-part behavior was tested separately.
